title: 'Hocus Pocus' Is No. 1 on Disney+ Before Halloween
summary:
Halloween is almost here, and an old favorite movie is on top again. 'Hocus Pocus,' a Disney film from 1993, is the No. 1 movie on Disney+, says FlixPatrol, a website that tracks streaming charts.

The movie stars Sarah Jessica Parker, Bette Midler and Kathy Najimy as the Sanderson Sisters, three wicked witches from the 1600s. A teenage boy named Max moves to Salem, Massachusetts, with his little sister Dani. Max accidentally brings the witches back! Max, Dani, their friend Allison and a talking cat named Thackery Binx team up to stop them.

The movie did not do well when it first came out in July. But over the years, many families started watching it every October.

For its 30th birthday in 2023, it even returned to the top 10 in movie theaters. Disney is now working on a third movie, 'Hocus Pocus 3.'
why_it_matters: It is a fun Halloween movie that many kids may watch with their families this month.
